title: Les Snead on Ty Simpson meeting: We didn't want teams to know our interest

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Les Snead on Ty Simpson meeting: We didn't want teams to know our interest
sources.description: After the Rams drafted quarterback Ty Simpson with the 13th pick last week, Simpson indicated that he'd never met with Rams head coach Sean McVay or General Manager Les Snead as part of the pre-draft process.
